anomaly_label: Increased distillate flow to distillate receiver (V003)

evidence.observation: H701 temperature reads 273.928 °C, markedly above H702 at 60.506 °C and the vessel at 50.330 °C.
T701 has risen monotonically to 278.499 °C while T702 remains 60.463 °C and T703 remains 50.415 °C; the isolated high, rising reading warrants verification.
Pressure and reflux remain broadly stable: PY23 500.431 mbar, PDI701 1.116 mbar, PDI702 1.780 mbar, FT704 1.930; no corresponding bulk-process disturbance is evident.

args.missing_evidence: H701 setpoint, power output and allowable temperature range, plus an independent heater-temperature measurement, are needed to distinguish actual overheating from sensor drift or an intended heater condition. No composition measurement or separation target is supplied.
